subject: Harbor Health — new project keys & staged rollout plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Harbor Health — new project keys & staged rollout plan

Emma — following up from yesterday’s call. Harbor confirmed they want to add two new application teams (Patient Insights & Scheduling) under the existing enterprise agreement and provision separate API keys for each app.

High level asks from our side so we can formalize the amendment and the rollout: 
- Confirm target go-live for each app (we heard: Patient Insights: July 12, Scheduling: Aug 2)
- Desired throughput/peak tokens for each app (estimated QPS or monthly tokens)
- Whether they want isolated keys per environment (prod/staging) or a shared key with role scoping
- Any procurement constraints on amended SLAs or billing cycles

I’ve attached a draft MAP (Redwood-Onboard-MAP-v2.xlsx) and an SLA amendment we typically use for multi-app expansions. If the timeline above looks right I propose a phased rollout: 
1) Provision dev/staging keys and run smoke tests (2 weeks)
2) Canary with Patient Insights (1 week at reduced capacity)
3) Full prod cutover for Patient Insights, then repeat for Scheduling

Can you confirm the go-live dates and whether procurement needs a PO or contract addendum? If yes, I’ll loop Legal and Sales Ops.

Thanks — Logan
--
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Emma Lin <emma.lin@harborhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Moreno <jake.moreno@harborhealth.com>, Harbor Health Procurement <procurement@harborhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Health — new project keys & staged rollout plan

Hi Logan — thanks, this aligns with our discussion. Quick clarifications: 
- Confirmed go-lives: Patient Insights target 2027-07-15 (pushed 3 days from what we said on the call), Scheduling target 2027-08-02.
- Throughput: Patient Insights ~2M tokens/month (models for analytics), Scheduling ~1M tokens/month. We may spike higher during pilot week.
- Keys: We prefer isolated keys per app and per env (prod/staging) for auditability. So that’s 4 keys total to start.
- Procurement: We need an addendum to the existing SOW and a PO for the delta spend. Procurement prefers invoices on net 45.

I’ve copied Jake and Procurement. Procurement will confirm PO timing and any required wording in the SLA.

Emma
Emma Lin
Director, Data Platform — Harbor Health
emma.lin@harborhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@harborhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Health — new project keys & staged rollout plan

Emma / team — looping in to propose a concrete rollout calendar and operational tasks. Based on the timeline and the four keys requested, suggested plan: 
- Week 1 (Jun 14–Jun 18): Provision dev/staging keys for both apps; integrate with Harbor CI and run simple health checks.
- Week 3 (Jun 28–Jul 2): Run load test for Patient Insights in staging (target 1.5x expected traffic).
- Week 4 (Jul 12–Jul 16): Patient Insights canary in prod at 20% traffic. Monitor latency, error-rate, cost per 1k tokens.
- Week 6 (Aug 2–Aug 6): Scheduling canary and then full cutover by Aug 9 provided canary is clean.

Operational asks: 
- Diego to produce a short forecast of expected concurrency and recommended instance sizing/commit for Dedicated if Harbor wants reserved capacity.
- Harbor to confirm whether they want automatic prefix caching enabled for Patient Insights (helps cost on repeated prompts).

I’ll draft the SOW addendum once procurement confirms PO timing. Attaching the MAP again as reference.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-Onboard-MAP-v2.xlsx
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emma Lin <emma.lin@harborhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Health — new project keys & staged rollout plan

Marissa / Emma — attaching a brief capacity note (sent inline):

Estimated baseline: 
- Patient Insights: 2M tokens/mo => ~0.8 rps average, 6–10 peak rps during analytics runs (recommend 2 x p4d equivalent for predictable latency if using hosted Dedicated).
- Scheduling: 1M tokens/mo => ~0.4 rps average, spike to 3–4 rps at peak.

Recommendations: 
- Start on Hosted API with smart batching and prefix cache enabled; monitor for 2–3 weeks. If sustained >3x spikes or strict latency SLOs, transition to Reserved (Dedicated) with a 30-day commit to get price predictability.
- We can generate four keys (prod/staging per app) and tag them with project IDs for billing separation.

Jake / Procurement — rough delta estimate for billing: +$6k/month incremental for expected usage on hosted tiers. If Harbor prefers Dedicated, I’ll model an alternate committed price.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@harborhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Health — new project keys & staged rollout plan

Thanks everyone — quick recap and next steps so the procurement/legal folks have an actionable list: 
- Marissa: please prepare SOW addendum template and flag any SLA language that Procurement typically requests (I called out invoice terms).
- Diego: please produce the Dedicated pricing worksheet if Harbor requests committed capacity; otherwise we default to hosted billing and monitor for three weeks after Patient Insights cutover.
- Emma / Harbor Procurement: confirm PO timing (net 45 ok) and provide any required legal contact for redlines.
- Redwood Ops: we will provision 4 keys (prod/staging x 2 apps) in the dev cluster next week and share key IDs in a secure doc.

If there are no objections I’ll set up a 30-minute kickoff for Monday Jun 14 10:00 AM PT to provision keys and walk through integration steps. Please reply with availability.

Best — Logan
